title: Hidden and unknowable, tracked
instructions: The same silent bot behind the wall. A scripted stand-in (not a human, not cheat software) aims your avatar at it through the wall and fires, as a reader of hidden positions would.

card.what_this_tests: Sustained aim on an enemy this client could neither see nor hear.
card.player_can_know: No: no line of sight, no sound, never perceived.
card.server_knows: Vision absent and audio absent for the hidden bot, both checked every tick; the aim cone held it between shots.
card.expected_fpsdet_behavior: KnowledgeState unknowable. The hidden-mover check fires: at least 8 shots with hidden time and 1200 ms in all. Decision review.
card.invalid_if: The bot made a sound, was seen, or was perceived within the last second: any of those makes it known.

caveats: A server-side stand-in aims the subject: the behaviour such software produces, not cheat code.
actor: SCRIPTED TEST STAND-IN (reader of hidden positions) · NOT A HUMAN · NOT REAL CHEAT SOFTWARE
